title: I Asked Developers to Max Out a $12 Server (again)
description:
I asked developers to build the fastest possible app on a $12 server, and you sent in a new round of submissions in Java, Kotlin, Scala, Swift, Haskell, Lua, Dart, Zig, V, and even hand-written assembly. Every entry runs the same small Twitter-like API on SQLite, on one vCPU and 2 GB of RAM, and has to hold the load for five minutes. We go through what each one built, which optimizations mattered, and what finally stopped it: CPU, memory, disk, or connections.

Code and full results: https://github.com/arjaythedev/twelve-dollar-server-challenge
Multi-core server challenge: https://github.com/arjaythedev/multicore-server-challenge
$20 of free Synteq credit to run these experiments yourself: https://synteq.com/arjay
Devmaxx, 7 days free: https://www.devmaxx.dev/get
